name: journal-romans-8
description: Notes expressing anger at God, on a chapter readers reach for as a platitude. The reply must meet the anger with Scripture rather than rebuke it, and must not flatten Romans 8:28 into a slogan.

notes.title: Six months on
notes.text: People keep telling me it will all work out for good. I want to throw the verse back at them. If this is the good, I do not understand what the word means any more.

notes.title: Honest
notes.text: I am angry with God and I do not know whether I am allowed to write that down.

journalingChat.question: Is it wrong to be angry with God about this?
